title: Workday Data Support Analyst
description:
Workday Data Support Analyst

A global technology-focused organisation is seeking a Workday Data Support Analyst to join its Application Support team and play a key role in the implementation and support of Workday Financials.


Working closely with project, finance, data and IT teams, you'll provide specialist support across Workday Prism Analytics, Accounting Centre and end-to-end data flows. This role will be heavily involved in UAT, go-live and post-implementation support, helping to resolve data issues, stabilise services and ensure a smooth transition into business-as-usual operations.

Key Responsibilities
  • Provide second-line support for Workday data services and integrations.
  • Investigate and resolve data quality, reconciliation and processing issues.
  • Analyse and troubleshoot complex data problems using SQL and other diagnostic tools.
  • Support Workday Financials UAT, go-live activities and post-implementation hypercare.
  • Work with internal stakeholders and third-party suppliers to resolve incidents and restore service.
  • Create and maintain support documentation, operational procedures and knowledge articles.
  • Support knowledge transfer and training activities to build long-term support capability.
About You

You'll have:

  • Experience supporting data-intensive enterprise applications.
  • Strong SQL skills and a proven ability to investigate data and integration issues.
  • Experience with Workday Prism Analytics, Accounting Centre or similar enterprise financial platforms.
  • Knowledge of data pipelines, interfaces and end-to-end data flows.
  • Experience supporting major system implementations, including UAT, go-live and transition-to-service activities.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to a range of stakeholders.
  • A collaborative approach and passion for sharing knowledge across teams.
What's on Offer
  • Hybrid working model (2-3 days per week in Manchester).
  • Opportunity to work on a major Workday Financials implementation.
  • Exposure to a complex enterprise environment and cutting-edge data technologies.
  • A collaborative culture with strong opportunities for learning and career development.

If you're an experienced Workday data professional looking to play a key role in a high-profile transformation programme please apply for the role.

Reasonable Adjustments:

Respect and equality are core values to us. We are proud of the diverse and inclusive community we have built, and we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and perspectives. Our success is driven by our people, united by the spirit of partnership to deliver the best resourcing solutions for our clients.

If you need any help or adjustments during the recruitment process for any reason, please let us know when you apply or talk to the recruiters directly so we can support you.
